description: This file declares cryptographic functions related to Bluetooth Audio CSIP, including hash, encryption, and decryption functions for SIRK (Set Identity Resolving Key).

methods.name: bt_csip_sih
methods.description: Generates a hash value used in RSIs for Bluetooth Audio CSIP.

methods.name: bt_csip_sef
methods.description: Encrypts the SIRK using a key K, depending on the pairing method.

methods.name: bt_csip_sdf
methods.description: Decrypts the SIRK using a key K, depending on the pairing method.
